# BasherConfirmator – Ultimate Purchase Confirmation System

![Minecraft Plugin Icon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-Plugin-success?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft)
![Spigot](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spigot-1.16+-orange?style=for-the-badge)
[![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://t.me/aleks_basher)
[![Site](https://img.shields.io/badge/Site-red?style=for-the-badge)](https://basherplugins.github.io)

> **The most elegant and flexible purchase confirmation system ever created for Minecraft servers.**

## ✨ Why BasherConfirmator?

Tired of accidental purchases ruining your players' experience? **BasherConfirmator** eliminates buyer's remorse with a sleek, configurable confirmation menu that works seamlessly with **any economy system** – or multiple simultaneously!

---

## 🔥 Core Features

### 🪙 Universal Economy Support
- **Plugin-agnostic design** – Works with Vault, PlayerPoints, GemsEconomy, TokenEnchant, and any custom economy
- **Multi-currency purchases** – Configure products to use different economy plugins simultaneously
- **Dynamic balance checking** – Real-time validation before purchase confirmation

### 🎨 Fully Customizable GUI
- **Beautiful menu designs** with full decoration control
- **Three interactive buttons**:
  - ✅ **Confirm Button** – Executes purchase commands
  - ❌ **Cancel Button** – Runs rollback commands
  - 🛒 **Product Button** – Displays item details and price
- **Material, name, lore, slot, flags and more** for every element
- **PlaceholderAPI depend** for dynamic economy support
